generated_by: Phase A0 Gate 6 — Product Maturity Truthfulness

maturity_scale.L1_ASSET_PRESENT: File exists on disk (rule file, prompt file, code file)
maturity_scale.L2_CONTRACT_PRESENT: API endpoint or schema exists but no implementation backing
maturity_scale.L3_CODE_PRESENT: Implementation code exists but not wired
maturity_scale.L4_RUNTIME_REACHABLE: Code is wired and can be invoked
maturity_scale.L7_WORKFLOW_CLOSED: End-to-end workflow completes (input → output → feedback loop)
maturity_scale.L8_QUALITY_BENCHMARKED: Formal quality benchmark (F1, agreement rate, etc.) passes
maturity_scale.L10_EXTERNAL_PARTNER_VALIDATED: Real partner or production user has run the workflow

principle: Existence of a rule file / API endpoint / prompt / handler / DB table does NOT mean the workflow is closed. Each China scenario claim must specify its actual maturity level.
